summary: American Honda Receivables LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a securitization of auto loan receivables. On May 5, 2026, the depositor and sponsor agreed with Barclays, Mizuho, SMBC Nikko, and SG to sell five classes of asset-backed notes from Honda Auto Receivables 2026-2 Owner Trust totaling $2,105,270,000. The notes bear fixed rates from 3.828% to 4.33% and a SOFR-linked tranche. Closing is expected May 13, 2026; AHFC will retain at least 5% of each class. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
